frames.alt: The boot menu of the stock Ubuntu 26.04.1 arm64 ISO
frames.shows: Plain white-on-black GRUB: Try or Install Ubuntu, Boot from next volume, UEFI Firmware Settings, and a 30 second countdown

frames.alt: The live session's boot log in plain text, about 30 s after Enter
frames.shows: systemd lines, cloud-init and snap seeding scroll by; there is no splash (the arm64 menu line carries console=tty0)

frames.alt: Canonical's installer window, open by itself on the live desktop: Choose your language
frames.shows: Page 1 of 13; English preselected; the wallpaper is Ubuntu's

frames.alt: Installer page 5: What do you want to do with Ubuntu, Install Ubuntu or Try Ubuntu

frames.alt: Installer page 11: Create your account, a name typed, the computer name and the user name filled in
frames.shows: The password fields show dots; the Show button was never pressed

frames.alt: Installer page 13: Review your choices, with the Install button
frames.shows: Lists the disk, the applications, encryption and the partitions

frames.alt: The install in progress: a slideshow and a segmented bar with Copying files
frames.shows: No percentage and no named stages

frames.alt: Installation complete: Restart now or Continue testing
frames.shows: First recorded at 00:31:28, so this frame is 4 minutes after the page appeared; it does not mention the USB stick

frames.alt: The installed system's greeter, 30 s after power-on

frames.alt: First sign-in: a full-screen Welcome to Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS and a Software Updater banner, 72 Updates Available
